seoTitle: How to Clear Cache in Shopify Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to clear browser, theme, app, and CDN cache in Shopify to fix outdated pages, missing changes, and display issues on your store.
intro: When changes to your Shopify store aren't showing up or pages look outdated, cached content is usually the culprit. This guide covers the different types of cache involved — browser, theme, app, and CDN — and how to clear each one to get your storefront up to date.

steps.heading: Understand how Shopify caching works
steps.body: Shopify pages can be cached at several layers, including your browser, the theme itself, installed apps, and Shopify's CDN, so a single fix doesn't always cover everything.

steps.heading: Clear browser cache
steps.body: Clear the cache for both the Shopify admin and your storefront in your browser, or use a hard refresh to force the latest version to load.

steps.heading: Do a proper hard refresh
steps.body: Use your browser's hard refresh shortcut to bypass locally cached files and pull a fresh copy of the page.

steps.heading: Clear theme and app-related cache
steps.body: Some themes and apps generate their own cached files, so check theme settings or app dashboards for a dedicated cache-clearing option.

steps.heading: Account for CDN cache delays
steps.body: Shopify's CDN can take a short time to propagate changes globally, so some delay after clearing local cache is normal.

faq.question: Why aren't my Shopify changes showing up immediately?
faq.answer: This is usually due to cached content at the browser, theme, app, or CDN level, which can take a short time to refresh after you clear it.

faq.question: How do I hard refresh a Shopify page?
faq.answer: Use your browser's hard refresh shortcut, which forces the page to reload without pulling from local cache.

faq.question: Can apps cause Shopify caching issues?
faq.answer: Yes, some apps cache their own content separately from the theme, so check individual app settings if changes made through an app aren't appearing.

faq.question: How long does Shopify's CDN cache take to update?
faq.answer: CDN propagation is usually fast, but it can take a little time to fully update across all regions after a change.
